info.name: Zuper REST Customers API
info.description:
The Zuper REST API provides programmatic access to the Zuper field service management platform. It covers jobs, scheduling, route optimization, customers, organizations, assets, inventory, purchase orders, invoices, proposals, quotes, timesheets, projects, properties, service tasks, service contracts, webhooks, and communications. Authentication uses API keys passed via the x-api-key header. Region-specific base URLs are discovered by POSTing to the accounts endpoint.

Contact Support:
 Name: Zuper Developer Support
